fields.description: Where this source reads from: a web address, records already on this site, or uploaded files (invoices, receipts, statements) the AI reads and turns into records. You choose it yourself — the AI never picks a source.
fields.label: Type

fields.description: What this source reads, and how many conditions narrow it down. Filled in for you from the settings below.
fields.label: What

fields.description: The only address this source ever downloads. You set it here — the AI can never point the task somewhere else.
fields.label: Source URL

fields.description: Which kind of record this source reads. Records are read as the Runs As user set for this use case, so anything that user cannot open is never sent to the AI.
fields.label: Record Type to Read

fields.description: Narrow down which records or files to read. Click the table to change them. You set these — the AI never adds a filter of its own.
fields.label: Which Records

fields.description: How many records — or files — to read at most in one run. Each file costs at least two AI calls, so a File Query source starts lower. If more match, this source picks up where it stopped on the next run — nothing is skipped.
fields.label: Per Run

fields.depends_on: eval:(doc.source_type=="Document Query"||doc.source_type=="File Query") && parent.trigger!="Document Event" && parent.trigger!="Incoming Email"
fields.description: Read only records that changed since this source was last read. Keep this on: with it off, every run sends every matching record to the AI again and you pay for all of them again.
fields.label: Changed

fields.description: Also read the files attached to each record, such as a PDF invoice that arrived by email. Crema reads PDFs and pictures only, at most five per record, and each one costs an AI call.
fields.label: Files

fields.description: How far this source has been read. Records changed after this time are read on the next run. Clear it to read everything again.
fields.label: Read Up To
